note: Class ids and full names match the model. Colours are used everywhere a class appears (overlay, list, charts).
disclaimer: This tool identifies symbols. It is not a vehicle diagnosis.

classes.name: Anti Lock Braking System
classes.meaning: The anti-lock braking system has a fault or is switched off.

classes.name: Braking System Issue
classes.meaning: The brake system needs attention, for example low brake fluid.

classes.name: Charging System Issue
classes.meaning: The battery is not being charged properly.

classes.name: Check Engine
classes.meaning: The engine management system has detected a fault.

classes.name: Electronic Stability Problem -ESP-
classes.meaning: Electronic stability control has a fault or is intervening.

classes.name: Engine Overheating Warning Light
classes.meaning: Engine coolant temperature is too high.

classes.name: Low Tire Pressure Warning Light
classes.meaning: One or more tyres are under-inflated.

classes.name: Master warning light
classes.meaning: A general alert; another light or message gives the detail.

classes.name: SRS-Airbag
classes.meaning: The airbag or restraint system has a fault.
